text: BAM share was flat over 25 hours and rose 0.07 percentage points over 7 days, leaving 32.8% of Solana stake routed through BAM. The single largest node, ams-mainnet-bam-2-tee, holds 22.9% of BAM stake, and the node Nakamoto coefficient is 3, so concentration remains elevated. The 58 leadership changes in this window fit whale-driven routing, not structural rollover.
